context: Coinbase confirms cbXRP can be redeemed to native XRP on eligible Exchange deposits; public Morpho data shows cbXRP liquidations and distinct LLTV markets. Downstream liquidator-to-Coinbase redemption and sale remain unobserved.
decisions: Model lifecycle separately: native XRP custody backing → cbXRP mint/transfer → Morpho collateral → liquidation seizure → liquidator disposition → optional Coinbase deposit/unwrap → native XRP balance → optional sale/withdrawal.
Mark liquidation seizure and Coinbase unwrap mechanism confirmed independently; liquidator-to-Coinbase transfer and native XRP sale remain UNKNOWN until exact transaction lineage is proven.
Maintain separate time series per Morpho market ID, chain, collateral/loan token, oracle, LLTV, liquidation penalty, curator, vault allocation, supply, borrow, utilization and liquidity.
Do not assume 62.5% LLTV is Coinbase's exclusive route; a separate 77% market exists and Coinbase does not disclose market routing.
Distinguish vault allocation from underlying market liquidity and total market supply/borrow; do not attribute USDC supply to Circle or Coinbase without supplier evidence.
Use Morpho public REST API only after endpoint, pagination, timestamp, rate-limit and historical completeness tests.

Treat liquidation/unwrap observations as collateral-risk and possible supply-transmission variables, not directional XRP price features until full transmission and out-of-sample value are established.
invariants: Seized cbXRP is not native XRP sold.
Coinbase unwrap capability is not proof a liquidator used it.
Native XRP credited to Coinbase is not proof of spot sale.
A liquidator address is not a verified person or institution.
Vault allocation is not full market supply or Coinbase loan volume.
Different LLTV markets are not interchangeable.
Circle issuing USDC does not establish Circle as a Morpho supplier.
